Name: TheDefective1's East Scarp (Jessie Only) Portraits
Author: TheDefective1
Description:
To use these portraits, just drag and drop the .PNG files into the portraits folder within the Portraiture mod folder, [If you're in the right spot, the file location should look like this: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\mods\Portraiture\Portraits] and that's it!

Once you're in game, go talk to Jessie and press 'P' until you see her portraits switch to this one! Then press 'O' to lock her onto that set of portraits, so that you can still change other NPCs portraits without changing hers too.

This mod is [u]also compatible with the standalone mod '[/u][u]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks' if you prefer[/u] that one over East Scarp, since the same naming rule applies no matter what with Portraiture- just ignore the requirement popup for East Scarp when downloading! My file comes with an extra portrait sheet in it, but that one will automatically be skipped over if it's not needed.

I'm working on portraits for characters from East Scarp that aren't included in a lot of portrait mods that are out so far. (Starting with the characters that I personally like the most!) I love seeing Jessie hanging out with Linus and checking in on him when no one else does, and being a general gem of an individual around town! 😤 I wanted to make something for her too because she feels so underrated...
